description: The contract lists 142 tests total (line 38) but does not include criteria for the following edge cases that ARE in the behavioral spec: (1) REQ-BILL-002 edge case: __Host-link_session cookie absent -- the subscribe test handles 'findLinkSession returns null' but no test specifically simulates cookie absence vs token-not-found. (2) REQ-BILL-007: canceled with access_end_at <= now allowing new subscription -- no test covers this re-subscription-after-expiry case explicitly. (3) REQ-BILL-017: 'no member' (null member) case for cancel -- the cancel test only tests status=null/paused/deleted but not the case where findMemberByDiscordUserId returns null, which is handled at cancel.ts line 41. (4) REQ-BILL-020: leap year boundary test -- only unit test covers leap year; no integration test covers cancel acceptance with leap year dates.

remediation: Add contract criteria requiring integration tests for: (1) explicit cookie-absent scenario distinct from token-not-found, (2) re-subscription after canceled+expired access_end_at, (3) cancel with null member (no row in members table), (4) cancel acceptance boundary with leap year dates at integration level.
